chunks: Then why, if you are not indebted (to Us for life),
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be 'indebted' to God in the context of Surah Al-Waqi'ah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical challenge underscores the inherent 'indebtedness' (maddini) of creation to the Creator, linking human accountability directly to divine grace rather than mere existence. It serves as a foundational argument for the Day of Judgment, where the lack of independent agency necessitates submission to God's decree. This concept reinforces the Shia emphasis on the balance between divine power (Qudrah) and human responsibility (Taklif).
